manual.note: Honda 2023 CR-V Owner's Manual, gas model (PDF, 700 pp). Specifications p.677, oil recommendation p.599, towing p.431, TPMS p.465-466. No battery capacity is printed. Printed page = PDF page - 1. Hybrid manual not read; this page covers the 1.5L turbo only.

oilCapacity.value: 1.5L turbo (gas): 3.7 US qt (3.5 L) with filter, 3.4 US qt (3.2 L) without
oilCapacity.appliesTo: 1.5L turbo gas model only; the 2.0L hybrid uses a different fill
oilCapacity.unverifiedNote: CR-V Hybrid oil capacity not covered on this page

oilViscosity.value: Honda Genuine Motor Oil 0W-20 or API service SN or higher grade 0W-20

batteryGroup.note: this edition prints no battery reserve-capacity or BCI group number

tpmsReset.value: Use the TPMS Calibration item in the vehicle settings menu: select Calibrate, then drive at 30-65 mph for about 30 minutes of cumulative driving. A TPMS calibration is required after tire inflation changes or wheel replacement.

tires.note: Compact spare: T155/90D17 112M at 60 psi. Cold pressures differ front/rear. Gas model only; hybrid wheel sizes are not covered here.
